Elena / team — quick update + attached results.

We completed the three scenarios in the plan in the Redwood staging pool (us-west-2). Summary findings: 
- Token exchange (OAUTH) flow: pass. Average token rotate latency 120ms, no refresh failures observed.
- KV-prefix caching: functional but cache hit ratio degraded under simulated concurrency >600 RPS; cause traced to a default TTL misconfiguration in SharedMesh SDK where prefix lifespan was 30s vs expected 5m. We attached the recorded telemetry and reproduction commands.
- Model fallback policy: pass on route fallback; we observed slightly higher egress latency when routing to eu-central variants (median +80ms), which is within our expectations.

Attachments: interop-test-results-20270520.csv (telemetry), run-log-5-20.txt, reproduction-curl.txt

Next steps we recommend:
1) SharedMesh to update prefix TTL in SDK (small change, low risk)
2) Re-run kv concurrency test after patch (target: hit ratio >85% at 800 RPS)
3) If re-run passes, we can generate the signoff artifact and share an SOW draft for production integration.

Dylan, Kim — can we schedule a 30-min triage next week if SharedMesh wants to pair on the repro?

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
